full.description: This clinical photograph shows the lower extremities and external genitalia of a newborn infant. The legs exhibit severe positioning abnormalities and deformities affecting the feet, characteristic of severe clubfoot (talipes equinovarus). The photograph captures the characteristic skeletal positioning commonly associated with Potter sequence or related oligohydramnios-induced deformations. The external genitalia are visible at the top of the frame between the widely spaced legs.

random.description: This clinical photograph shows the lower extremities and external genitalia of an infant. There is a prominent structural deformity of both feet, specifically bilateral clubfoot (talipes equinovarus). The legs are symmetrically positioned, highlighting the congenital positioning abnormalities. Such findings are typically associated with musculoskeletal developmental disorders or postural deformities observed in newborns.
